title: Pet-Friendly Hosting Terms: Listing Pet Fees and HostCover Pet-Damage Settlements
content:
A listing's pet fee bears on how much of a pet-damage loss **Host Damage Protection (HostCover)** settles. The pet-fee share follows the pet fee the listing under the plan charges per stay, because the pet fee the guest paid is charged for the extra cleaning and upkeep a pet brings, in the way the base settlement reduces a deep-cleaning claim by the cleaning fee collected, so part of the pet's impact has already been paid for on the stay: a listing charging a pet fee of 100.00 or more settles the pet damage at 80 percent, a listing charging a pet fee above 0.00 but below 100.00 at 90 percent, and a listing charging no pet fee in full. The percentage applies to the pet-damage loss being settled, before any guest payment or deductible comes off it.

The pet fee read is the pet fee per stay that Listings records for the listing the HostCover plan covers; a pet fee of 0.00 means pets are not charged.

| Pet fee per stay on the listing (Listings) | Pet damage settled at |
|---|---|
| 0.00 (no pet fee) | in full |
| above 0.00 and below 100.00 | 90 percent |
| 100.00 or more | 80 percent |

## Either side of the bands (hypothetical listings)

| Pet fee | Settled at |
|---|---|
| 0.00 | in full |
| 0.01 | 90 percent |
| 99.99 | 90 percent |
| 100.00 | 80 percent |
| 150.00 | 80 percent |

A pet-damage loss of 1500.00 on a listing with a pet fee of 75.00 enters the settlement at 1350.00; with a pet fee of 125.00, at 1200.00.
